verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim built-in fine-grained reactive state updates via Angular Signals and first-party dependency injection, which are exactly the kind of built-in primitives the story asks for. However, the evidence is only marketing-level one-liners and never explicitly documents app-wide or global state sharing (e.g., signal-based singleton services). missing for 10: explicit documentation of global or shared state patterns using signals and DI, in-depth state-management guides, independent or hands-on corroboration that no third-party store is needed.
